assets.prompt:
Create a production WALK CYCLE KEYFRAME SHEET, eight deliberately DIFFERENT sequential poses of the same hooded traveller from the reference. Transparent RGBA background. Exactly FOUR COLUMNS, TWO ROWS. Same fixed camera, right-facing side profile in every cell. SAME adult proportions, same charcoal coat, backpack bedroll, lantern in right hand, left arm free. Coat to just below knees with a simple split hem so legs can be read. Realistic sombre graphite painted style. SMALL NATURAL WALK, straight knees aligned forward, feet facing right.

This is a technical animation keyframe sheet: it is crucial that feet are TOGETHER under the body in frames 3 and 7, and separated in frames 1 and 5. Do not draw eight strides. Follow these eight poses exactly, reading left to right:
1. CONTACT: right boot heel forward on floor, left boot toe behind; free arm back, lantern forward slightly; hips low.
2. DOWN: weight over right foot, right knee slightly flexed, left heel lifting and knee starting forward; shoulders sink.
3. PASSING: right leg STRAIGHT and VERTICAL directly beneath hip, left knee swings forward past it, left boot raised only slightly; boots close together horizontally. Torso over supporting foot, shoulders rotated.
4. UP: right heel lifts behind while left leg extends toward next step; torso rises and free arm comes forward.
5. CONTACT: LEFT boot forward, RIGHT toe behind. Opposite limb arrangement from frame 1, hips rotated, shoulders counter-rotated, free arm forward, lantern swings back.
6. DOWN: left foot supports bent knee, right heel lifts and swings. Torso sinks.
7. PASSING: LEFT leg STRAIGHT VERTICAL below hip; right leg passes, raised boot close horizontally to planted boot. Opposite arms from frame 3.
8. UP: left heel lifts, right leg extends toward frame 1, torso rises, arm swings back.

The whole body must act: shoulders/hood/hips/arms/pack/coat shift naturally, no frozen upper body. Character stays centred in each cell, single common scale, equal ground baselines, full body visible, generous transparent margins. No frame numbers, no text, no scenery, no contact shadow, no grey backdrop or fake checkerboard. 1536x1024.

Create a matching animation asset for the SAME hooded traveller in the reference. Exactly EIGHT complete bodies in a FOUR COLUMN TWO ROW transparent RGBA sheet. This time the traveller walks TOWARD THE CAMERA, FRONT VIEW seen from a slightly elevated angle. All eight face front, hood face is completely black. Same realistic adult anatomy, dark charcoal worn knee-length coat, small backpack with rolled blanket visible above shoulders, dark trousers and heavy boots. A small physical lantern in the traveller's right hand (on IMAGE LEFT) swings gently, other arm swings naturally. Keep hand/lantern on same anatomical side throughout. Monochrome graphite painted game sprite.

Eight different chronological full-body poses of ONE two-step slow realistic walk:
1 right foot forward, left behind, hips rotated, weight low.
2 weight on right, right knee soft, left heel lifting, torso dips.
3 LEFT leg passes forward alongside right supporting straight leg, feet nearly side by side, shoulders counter-rotate.
4 left foot extends toward next contact, right heel lifts, torso rises.
5 LEFT foot forward, right behind; opposite arms/shoulder/hip arrangement from 1.
6 weight on left, left knee soft, right heel lifting, torso dips.
7 RIGHT leg passes forward alongside left straight support, feet nearly side by side, opposite shoulder/hip arrangement from 3.
8 right foot approaches next contact, left heel lifts, torso rises.
Feet travel forward/back in perspective, not sideways: hips are narrow and knees point forward, NO BOW LEGS, no pigeon toes, no outward crooked knees. Boots don't get longer to depict perspective. Restrained natural motion in shoulders, head, coat and arms, realistic movement of WHOLE body. Cloth follows the legs instead of a frozen cutout torso. Normal measured walking, no marching, no exaggerated swing. Keep same proportions and scale every frame, hips centred and common ground baseline in equal cells. Whole head to boots visible, ample empty margins. Genuine transparent alpha background, no backdrop, checkerboard, numbers, text, shadows, scenery or floor. 1536x1024.

Create a matching animation asset of this SAME hooded traveller, but walking AWAY from camera: BACK VIEW in every cell, slightly elevated game camera. Exactly EIGHT full-body keyframes in FOUR columns TWO rows, genuine transparent RGBA, 1536x1024. Same charcoal hooded knee-length split coat, narrow natural hips, adult straight legs and practical dark boots, backpack with rolled bedroll, small brass lantern carried in RIGHT hand (IMAGE RIGHT in back view), free left arm swinging. The back of the hood and backpack are visible in all frames. Graphite realistic painted style with readable grey cloth texture, serious restrained horror aesthetic.

Make a clear complete slow two-step walking cycle with DIFFERENT poses. 1 right foot ahead, left trailing with sole slightly visible; 2 weight down on right, left heel lifts; 3 left passes beside straight planted right leg, feet nearly together; 4 left reaches ahead, right heel lifts; 5 left ahead, right trailing with sole slightly visible; 6 weight down on left, right heel lifts; 7 right passes beside straight planted left leg, feet nearly together; 8 right reaches ahead, left heel lifts. Back perspective means trailing boot is nearer viewer, leading foot smaller/higher. Do not make a sequence of identical standing silhouettes. Weight visibly shifts between hips, shoulders counter-rotate, free arm swings, lantern follows hand, coat parts and cloth lag with the moving knees. Subtle hood/backpack bounce. Natural narrow walking track, no bow legs, no sideways knees, no outstretched marching. No long smeared boots. Consistent body proportions, scale and centred hip position in each equal cell, shared floor baseline, all body parts fully inside cell with generous clear space between figures. No ground, cast shadows, background, fake checkerboard, text, numbers or grid.

Create a matching RESTING POSE sheet for the same charcoal hooded traveller in these references, production painted graphite game sprites. EXACTLY THREE full bodies, arranged in THREE equal columns in ONE row on genuine transparent alpha background. First: right-facing PROFILE. Second: BACK view (walking away camera orientation). Third: FRONT view (toward camera orientation). Slightly elevated game camera same as references. In ALL views the traveller has STOPPED WALKING: both boots firmly planted on ground, relaxed natural narrow stance, legs straight without locking knees, feet beside each other with only a tiny stagger. Not a walking contact pose. Natural weight slightly on one leg, shoulders relaxed, free hand relaxed low, other hand holding small brass lantern. Right hand holds lantern (image left for front view, image right for back view). Worn charcoal knee-length coat, trousers and practical boots, hood face black, backpack with rolled bedroll. Same realistic adult proportions and costume as the references, no giant boots, no bow legs, no stretched limbs. Realistic subtle cloth folds, resting coat hangs down naturally. Same scale and common floor baseline in every cell, complete bodies with head and boots visible and generous transparent margins. This is source artwork for a quiet breathing idle animation. No labels, text, floor, shadows, background, fake checkerboard or grid. 1536x1024.
